name: brand-outreach
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：brand-outreach。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Drafts brand-pitch and collaboration outreach emails using the creator's real verified vault analytics, selects target brands, and manages the outreach pipeline. Use when the user wants to pitch brands, find sponsorship contacts, reply to brand inquiries, negotiate rates, or track outreach status. Draft-first by design — never sends without explicit human approval.
